decisionsTitle: «Confirmă prezența (opțional)» and «Cine vine (N)» stand together near the top, and the facts say how many come (amending §812, §819)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-19 14:25:** «„Cine vine" trebuie să fie mai vizibil. Că inițial am citit în „zig-zag" și am sărit peste secțiune. Și pune „Confirmă prezența (opțional)", ceva de genul.» §812 and §819 made the turn-up card and the races' list closed folds; on a race the list sat under «Condiții de participare», near the bottom, and on a group run the names were inside the card's own fold, behind a bar that said «Vii?». A reader who skims never opened either. This changes where they are and what they are called — it shows nothing new, and the disclosure rule (§143, §396, §812) is untouched.

**Decision.**

1. **The card is «Confirmă prezența (opțional)»** (EN «Confirm you're coming (optional)»; amends §812). Its closed line reads «Confirmă prezența (opțional) · 3 vin», «… · Fii primul care confirmă» while nobody has answered, «… · Tu vii ✓ · 3 vin» once the island knows the browser answered (`domain/summary.ts`, the §819 rule unchanged), and the sentence under it says in words that it is not a registration: «Nu e o înscriere: ne ajută să știm câți venim.» The anchor `#vin` stays: §815's calendar lines, the listing's chip and the link page land on it. «Vii?» remains the name of the **day-before email question** (§818) and of its topic — that is a message, not this card.

2. **«Cine vine (N)» on a turn-up event is a closed fold of its own, right under the card** (`RsvpCount`, amends §811 and §812). The same bar as the races' list — a real `h2` in the summary, the people glyph, the count on its line, 44 pixels — closed on arrival, at `#cine-vine`; inside, the names of those who ticked «Vreau să apar cu numele» and «și încă N» for the rest, exactly the §812 rule. It is drawn whenever the card is, from the **one read of the answers** the page already makes (`rsvps`, the same the card and the calendar links are handed — no second read); nobody yet: the bar says «Cine vine» without a number and the fold «Încă nu a confirmat nimeni.»; while the database is away it draws nothing (§281). The card no longer holds the list.

3. **«Cine vine (N)» on a race moves up** (amends §819; position only). `StartList` is drawn right under the registration card — the place the turn-up bars have — not under «Condiții de participare». The page's top is now facts → the registration card or «Confirmă prezența (opțional)» → «Cine vine (N)» → the rest as before. Nothing inside the list changes.

4. **The facts say how many come** (`EventFacts`, new `whoComes` prop). One more line with the people glyph, **«N vin · vezi cine»** (EN «N coming · see who», the house's count form: «1 vine»), whose words are a 44-pixel link to the fold with the names — `#cine-vine` on a turn-up event the page offers «Vin!» to, `#start-list-title` on a race whose public list is shown; the browser, or `OpenFoldFromHash`, opens the fold. The number is the fold's own: on a turn-up event the page's one read of the answers; on a race **the list's own title number**, which `StartList` used to compute inside itself and which now comes from one function both ask (`readStartListHead`, `events/ui/start-list-head.ts`: the counts, the places line's in-progress holds and the headline of §632/§647) — one computation over the public cache's reads, asked once per request, so the line cannot disagree with the title and costs no query of its own. Nothing when no count is public: nobody yet, «Arată public numărătoarea» off (§647), no list, a members' event, the preview, the database away — and on a race, nothing once the event is cancelled or completed or its start has passed (the very reading `rsvpOffered` gives the turn-up branch, and the facts' weather row): its list and names stay for their days, but nobody is «coming» to an event that will not happen or has happened. The calendar's and the members' zone's «Fii primul care spune că vine.» (§815) keep their words; only the card's own closed line says «Fii primul care confirmă».

**Refused.** A count of zero in the facts («0 vin» — the fold says it). Showing the names in the facts or on the bars. A second read of the answers or of the list's counts for the line. A separate number for the line (it would drift from the title). Opening the fold by default. Moving the interest box or the five steps (the list takes the slot the turn-up bars have; those stay where they were). A new decision about who may see a name, a new table or a new dependency.
changelogLine: - **«Cine vine» is easy to find** — the group run's card is «Confirmă prezența (opțional)» with «Nu e o înscriere» under it and «Cine vine (N)» a closed fold of its own right beneath, a race's list sits under the registration card instead of the rules, and the facts say «N vin · vezi cine», a link that opens the names. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: This replaces the card's name and its closed-line words in the criterion that names «Vii? · 3 vin» and «Vii? · Fii primul care spune că vine.» (the fold, its id `vin` and the server-side open are unchanged). Given an event the page offers «Vin!» to, when it renders, then «Confirmă prezența (opțional)» (`#vin`) and «Cine vine (N)» (`#cine-vine`) are two closed folds one under the other, the names only in the second and only as the public-name rule allows, the second bar without a number and its fold «Încă nu a confirmat nimeni.» while nobody has confirmed; and given an event the page does not offer, a members' event or the preview, then neither fold is drawn (2026-10-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given an event whose public list is shown, when the page renders, then the list is drawn right under the registration card, before «Condiții de participare», and nothing inside it changes; and given a count that is public — the answers of a «Vin!» event, or the list's own title number — then the facts carry «N vin · vezi cine», a link to `#cine-vine` or `#start-list-title` with the very number the fold's bar says, from the one read the fold uses, and carry nothing when no count is public (nobody yet, «Arată public numărătoarea» off, no list, a members' event, the preview) or when the event is cancelled, completed or already started (2026-10-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).
